text:
```yaml
name: CI with gz-physics

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Dart
      uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
      with:
        sdk: '2.14'
        architecture: 'x64'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y libgz-physics-dev

    - name: Build and test
      run: |
        mkdir build && cd build
        cmake ..
        make
        ctest --output-on-failure
```
